news.headline: Commanders WR Stefon Diggs sidelined by hamstring injury at Wednesday practice
news.summary: Diggs did not practice Wednesday because of a hamstring issue, alongside fellow WR Terry McLaurin with the same injury, putting his Week 5 availability in real doubt heading into Friday's final report.

news.headline: Ravens WR Zay Flowers back on the field for Friday practice
news.summary: Flowers practiced Friday alongside Trey Hendrickson and Ronnie Stanley, a positive sign after being banged up earlier in the week, though his Sunday night status still hinges partly on who's at QB.

news.headline: Lamar Jackson doesn't practice, still not officially ruled out for Week 5
news.summary: Jackson sat out again with his sprained ankle and looks more likely than not to miss Sunday night against Atlanta, with Tyler Huntley taking first-team reps all week as the probable starter if Jackson sits.

news.headline: Ja'Marr Chase still working through concussion protocol ahead of Dolphins game
news.summary: Chase has not cleared the NFL's five-phase concussion protocol as of this week and remains day-to-day, with coach Zac Taylor giving no timetable — a real chance he sits Sunday at Miami.

news.headline: Bengals WR Tee Higgins trending up, set for limited practice as Chase stays in protocol
news.summary: Higgins progressed from a DNP earlier in the week to a limited practice as the Bengals prepare for Miami, a good sign for his Sunday availability on the adductor/groin injury; his role would grow further if Chase can't go.

news.headline: Chargers' 2026 depth chart confirms Justin Herbert as the unquestioned starter
news.summary: Public depth charts list Herbert first on the Chargers with no ambiguity, underscoring that the QB currently started in your live Sleeper lineup (a New Orleans backup) belongs on your bench, not him.

news.headline: Saints QB Tyler Shough dealing with sore left hand, expects to play Sunday
news.summary: Shough was banged up on his non-throwing hand in Monday's loss to Atlanta but was limited in practice and said it won't affect him meaningfully — he's on track to start for New Orleans against Minnesota, just not for your Chargers slot.

news.headline: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley week-to-week with hamstring injury
news.summary: Barkley left Philadelphia's loss to the Rams early with a hamstring injury and is considered week-to-week; if he sits in London, Will Shipley would lead the Eagles backfield with Dameon Pierce behind him — one more reason the Jaguars' defense and Brenton Strange's matchup are softer than usual.
